characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows (Books/Films)
characters.summary: Bellatrix Lestrange is a fanatical and exceptionally lethal dark witch who relies on advanced curses, unhinged combat aggression, and mastery of the Unforgivable Curses. She fights at range using her wand to cast lethal or torturous spells.
weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence when toying with opponents
limitations: Vulnerable to surprise attacks when distracted by arrogance

sources.supports: Abilities, feats, duels, and magical prowess.

feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows (Books/Films)
characters.summary: The Bloody Baron is the ghost of Slytherin House, capable of generating chilling cold and operating as an incorporeal entity. As a ghost, physical attacks pass right through him, though he commands fear and commands respect among Hogwarts spirits.

mechanisms: Incorporeal ghost form immune to physical damage

weaknesses: Guilt-ridden and submissive toward Helena Ravenclaw
limitations: Cannot physically interact with the living world beyond chilling effects and ghostly presence

sources.supports: Ghostly attributes, history, and incorporeal nature.

feats.claim: Terrified Peeves the Poltergeist into submission, being the only entity Peeves truly fears.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

feats.claim: Existed for over a thousand years as a Hogwarts resident ghost stained with silver blood.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

unknowns: Exact magical limits of his ghostly interaction with physical objects

characters.summary: Pickett is a tiny, tree-dwelling Bowtruckle kept by Newt Scamander. He is peaceful by nature, defending himself primarily through stealth, climbing, and sharp fingers useful for picking locks.
weaknesses: Extremely fragile physical body due to tiny size
limitations: Vulnerable to capture due to diminutive size

sources.supports: Bowtruckle abilities, camouflage, and physical scale.

feats.claim: Picked a lock with his sharp fingers to free Newt Scamander and Tina Goldstein from execution.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

campaignTags.claim: Naturally blends in with wood and foliage to hide from enemies.

characters.summary: Credence Barebone is a powerful and unstable individual harboring an Obscurus—a dark, destructive parasitic magical force born from suppressed magic. When unleashed, he transforms into a massive, violent vortex of dark energy capable of leveling city blocks.

mechanisms: Incorporeal or swirling energy form resistant to physical strikes

weaknesses: Shortened lifespan due to the nature of the Obscurus
limitations: Cannot maintain human form indefinitely when consumed by the Obscurus

sources.supports: Obscurus powers, destructive feats, and magical nature.

feats.claim: Generated massive shockwaves capable of tearing through magical barriers in Paris.
